## Introduction

**Purpose:** Summarize country-year conflict histories and identify countries with long conflict periods and at least ten years of post-conflict data.

**Date started:** 2026-10-06 (earliest recorded Git version).

**Status:** Work in progress; the required country-year input is not currently included in the local data directory.

**Code style:** Use focused code cells, descriptive `snake_case` names, and repository-relative paths.

## Data description

This analysis is intended for the UCDP Country-Year Dataset on Organized Violence within Country Borders, version 26.1: [UCDP data portal](https://ucdp.uu.se/downloads/#orgviocy).

See Davies, Pettersson, and Öberg (2026), [“Organized violence 1989–2025, and violent political protests”](https://doi.org/10.1093/jopres/xjag046), and Sundberg and Melander (2013), “Introducing the UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset.”

## Analysis

```{python}
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
```

```{python}
ucdp_path = Path("../data/ucdp/raw/ucdp_country_year.csv")
ucdp = pd.read_csv(ucdp_path)
```

```{python}
ucdp.head()
print(ucdp.columns)
```

```{python}
violence_types = ucdp.groupby("country").agg(
    first_year=('year', 'min'),
    last_year=('year', 'max'),
    total_years=('year', 'count'),
    state_based = ('sb_exist', 'any'),
    non_state = ('ns_exist', 'any'),
    one_sided = ('os_exist', 'any')
).reset_index()

violence_types["overall_years"] = (
    violence_types["last_year"] - violence_types["first_year"] + 1
)
print(
    violence_types[
        [
            "country",
            "first_year",
            "last_year",
            "overall_years",
            "state_based",
            "non_state",
            "one_sided",
        ]
    ].sort_values(by="country", ascending=False)
)
```
